note: Golden FactPackets for the Hot Tape P2 wire desk (engine/marketing/hot_tape_llm.py). Each entry carries the packet, a plausible DETERMINISTIC wire-template rendering (fallback_text, what Phase 1's radar would post on its own), and a human-written wire post whose every number is packet-derived (good_phrasing). P1-P3 use the operator's 2026-07-28 corpus exemplars verbatim. Shapes only — no live tape data.

packets.shape: SNDK-shape mover_drop: number stacking that zooms out (D1) + dollar translation (D2) + since-date (D3)
packets.fallback_text: $SNDK -17% today, -30% over 5 days, -55% from its high. About $200 billion of market cap gone since 2026-06-22.
packets.good_phrasing: BREAKING: SanDisk stock, $SNDK, falls over -17% on the day, now down -30% in 5 days and -55% from its record high. That's officially over -$200 billion in lost market cap since June 22nd.

packets.shape: META streak_rarity: streak count (D4) + rarity window
packets.fallback_text: $META has closed red 9 sessions in a row. The last run like this was over 5 years ago.
packets.good_phrasing: Meta $META has not seen a double digit streak of red daily candles in over 5 years. Today is Day #9.

packets.shape: NVDA threshold_cross: dollar translation at trillion scale + distance from the record high
packets.fallback_text: $NVDA is -18.5% from its record high set on 2026-06-30. That is $1 trillion of market cap gone.
packets.good_phrasing: $1 TRILLION has been wiped out from $NVDA marketcap as it crashes -18.50% from its ALL TIME HIGH.

packets.shape: sector_rout: median + breadth + the three worst names. No primary cashtag - the sector is the subject.
packets.fallback_text: Semiconductors on the tape today: median -4.8%, 24 of 26 names red. $NVDA -6.1%, $AMD -5.4%, $AVGO -4.9%.
packets.good_phrasing: Semiconductors are getting wrecked today. The median chip name is -4.8% and 24 of 26 are red. $NVDA -6.1%, $AMD -5.4%, $AVGO -4.9%.

packets.shape: signal_fired: our own proprietary event - a live price crossing a Prophet plan level. Carries a site link.
packets.fallback_text: $COHR just crossed our 112.40 plan level, trading 112.55 and +2.1% today.
packets.good_phrasing: $COHR just took out the 112.40 level from our plan. It is trading 112.55 right now, +2.1% on the day.
